caption:
This morning: Google upgraded Search with Gemini 4 so AI Mode answers harder questions, and I asked whether it cites you.

Three new data points. Profound: AI Mode cites 15.2 sources per run, vs 11.1 for AI Overviews. A study: 18.8 points fewer clicks to outside sites in AI Mode. PPC Land: 1 billion monthly users, with queries 3x longer.

My take: more citations don't mean more visits. Measure citations and clicks separately.

Comment GEO and I will send you the details by DM.

Sources in the first comment.

scenes: This morning: Google put Gemini 4 into Search to answer complex questions, with more visual answers and a wider range of links. I went back in to check the numbers.
First, Profound measured AI Mode at 15.2 citations per run, against 11.1 for AI Overviews and 6.6 for the Gemini app.
Second, a study found people assigned to AI Mode clicked out to websites 18.8 percentage points less often than on normal Google.
Third, AI Mode passed one billion monthly users in May, and PPC Land reports its queries run three times longer than classic search.
My take: more citations don't mean more visits. Track citations and clicks separately, then decide where your content effort actually goes.
